text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. When you ask a voice assistant a question, get movie suggestions, or use a translation app, you are using AI. It also helps doctors and improves safety in cars. AI is changing the way we live and work.
